description: Codex Shepherd guard wiring (packages/harness-codex, DF-75). PostToolUse(spawn_agent|collaborationspawn_agent) tags each spawned agent with its dispatched role (src/dispatch-record.mjs) -- Codex's own analog of hooks/scripts/agent_invocation_tagger.sh, since nothing sets a SHEPHERD_ROLE env var for a Codex subprocess. PreToolUse(apply_patch|Bash) resolves that role, then relays write-boundary/git-custody evaluation to the shared `shepherd guard eval` engine (services/cli/shepherd_cli/predicates.py) -- src/guard.mjs is the thin translator, never a predicate interpreter itself.
